entities.name: Bria
entities.description: A legendary otter rogue and notorious thief from Bloomburrow who plagues Fountainport.

entities.name: Glarb
entities.description: King of Fountainport whose guards dispersed the crowd.

entities.name: Byrke
entities.description: A rabbit constable Bria considers her rival and friend.

events.summary: Bria plants a banner above the throne room promising free food courtesy of Glarb; the crowd is dispersed by Glarb's guards and the shops are pilfered.
events.quote: Word got around and the animalfolk showed up in droves, demanding a succulent meal, only to be dispersed by King Glarb and his guards.

relations.note: She calls the rabbit constable her rival and friend; he does not feel the same.
relations.quote: considering the rabbit constable her rival and friend, though the feeling is very much not mutual
